items.detail: **Friday's October jobs report** is the week's main event, with economists expecting about **55,000** new jobs and unemployment holding at 4.2%.
items.why: Strong hiring would firm up the roughly 83% odds of a December rate hike, while a weak report would ease them.

items.detail: **Apple** and Palantir report Monday after the close and **AMD** reports Tuesday, a fresh AI test for a Nasdaq that enters the week at **25,437**.
items.why: After last week's Big Tech selloff, any sign of AI spending outrunning profits could deepen the Nasdaq's slide.

items.detail: **Tuesday's midterm elections** decide control of Congress, with the **S&P 500** starting the week near 7,580 and Monday's ISM factory survey also due.
items.why: A surprise result could shift the outlook for spending and tax policy, while rising ISM prices would add to inflation worries.

items.detail: **Brazil's central bank decides Wednesday**, with the Selic at **13.75%**: economists expect a quarter-point cut, but traders lean toward a hold.
items.why: A cut while the Fed leans toward hikes would test emerging-market currencies already strained by a strong-dollar outlook.

items.detail: **State Bank of India** reports results Tuesday in a heavy earnings week, as the **Nifty 50** tries to build on last week's 2% gain to 23,053.
items.why: Foreign buyers returned last week, and solid bank earnings would help keep that money flowing into India.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** faces **Friday's jobs report** and the midterms, in a November that has historically been strong for small caps in midterm years.
items.why: Small companies borrow more, so a hot jobs report that raises hike odds would hit them hardest.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** starts the week near **$78,000**, still shaken by the Binance heist, with the midterms Tuesday and **Friday's jobs report** as the big tests.
items.why: A strong jobs number would lift rate-hike bets and the dollar, keeping pressure on bitcoin after last week's ETF outflows.

items.detail: **Ether** enters the week near **$2,246** as Ethereum's **Devcon 8** conference runs Tuesday to Friday in Mumbai, with the delayed Glamsterdam upgrade still undated.
items.why: A clear upgrade timeline could slow four straight weeks of ether ETF outflows, while more delays would weigh on sentiment.

items.detail: **Solana** sits near **$96** with no network event this week, after US Solana ETFs posted their biggest weekly withdrawals since launch.
items.why: Without a catalyst, Solana trades on risk appetite, so Friday's jobs report and fund flows will set its direction.

items.detail: **Gold** bounced to about **$3,906** Monday, just above Friday's one-year low, ahead of **Friday's US jobs report**.
items.why: Weak hiring would cut December hike bets and support gold, while strong numbers could push it toward $3,800.

crossCuttingTheme: Friday's US jobs report decides whether markets keep betting on a December Fed hike; strong hiring would lift the dollar and yields, squeezing gold, crypto, emerging markets and small caps all at once.
